operations.source_name: HM Land Registry technical guidance for GML files
operations.details_summary: Exact polygon containment and metric parcel calculations remain in British National Grid / EPSG:27700; web-display reprojection is not used as the measurement geometry.

operations.source_name: HM Land Registry technical guidance for GML files
operations.details_summary: HMLR warns that conversion from British National Grid to WGS84 may shift some features by up to 15 metres; therefore reprojected web geometry is rejected for exact point-in-polygon evidence.
A visually aligned web map does not prove metric-coordinate identity. Any transformed display geometry must remain separate from the EPSG:27700 measurement geometry and exact source bytes.

operations.source_name: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite Digital Surface Model DSM 1m
operations.details_summary: Official EA 1m DSM metadata states that the surface model includes object heights such as vehicles, buildings and vegetation as well as the terrain surface.
DSM elevation is not bare-earth terrain height. Building, vegetation or vehicle returns must not be silently interpreted as parcel ground relief.

operations.source_name: Environment Agency DTM and DSM contracts
operations.details_summary: EA DTM remains the terrain-height primary because surface objects are removed; DSM is retained only as a semantic negative-control source and is not substituted into the three measured parcel ranges.
Any raster identified as DSM instead of DTM fails the parcel terrain-height input gate unless the task explicitly requests surface-object height; no fallback substitution is allowed.
